```{r}
 ggplot(data=penguins, mapping = aes(x= flipper_length_mm,
```

```{r}
PlantGrowth
ggplot(data=PlantGrowth, mapping=aes(y=weight, x=group)) + geom_point(alpha=0.5) + stat_summary(geom = "pointrange", fun.data = "mean_se",color="purple")

```

```{r} 
glimpse(flights)
flights |> 
  filter(month == 1 & day == 1)
  flights |> 
    arrange(desc(month))
  flights |> 
      distinct(origin,dest)
```

```{r}
flights |>
```
